name: Scorechain
description:
Scorechain's blockchain compliance and AML risk analysis is now available as a Claude.ai connector via the Model Context Protocol.

What's included:

- Risk scoring — real-time AML risk scoring for any blockchain address across supported chains
- Address intelligence — entity labels, metadata, asset holdings, transaction history, and original funder identification
- Fund flow visualization — Sankey diagrams and interaction flowcharts showing where funds came from and where they went
- Transaction lookup — full transaction details by hash
- Search — cross-entity search over addresses, transactions, cases, labels, and lists
- Blockchain coverage — query supported chains and their coverage level

_published_faq.name: How do I add Scorechain to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Scorechain to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.scorechain.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Scorechain MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Scorechain provides these MCP tools: get_address, get_address_assets, get_address_funder, get_address_transactions, get_asset_holders, get_transaction, list_blockchains, score_address, search, visualize_fund_flow, visualize_interactions, and get_entity_types.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Scorechain?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Scorechain in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Scorechain requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Scorechain is developed by Scorechain. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
